user.t:
Translate two Markdown documents into Norwegian Bokmal and save each as a new file next to its English source. Do not touch any other file, do not run git, do not run tests.

Sources (in C:\Users\mariu\ventures\ap-recovery):
1. README.md -> README.no.md
2. ARCHITECTURE.md -> ARCHITECTURE.no.md

Rules:
- Faithful translation: keep the exact structure, headings order, tables, bullet lists, and every number, date, percentage, identifier, file path, env var (APR_*), code block, command, URL, API route, rule id (DUP-EXACT etc.) and product/company name unchanged. Do NOT translate content inside code blocks or inline code.
- Keep all caveats, status banners and disclaimers (pre-product, DRAFT, crowded category, weak moat, not legal advice) with the same strength. Do not add, remove or soften claims. Do not invent any new facts or figures.
- Keep the first-line copyright notice wording in English-compatible form ("(c) 2026 Marius Carlsson (socrates6969) - eier og opphavsrettshaver. Proprietaert; alle rettigheter forbeholdt." is fine).
- Relative links to other .md files should keep pointing to the English files (leave link targets unchanged); translate only the link text.
- Natural, precise Norwegian suited to finance/software people. No emojis. Use ASCII-friendly characters where the English uses them; Norwegian letters (ae, oe, aa as ae/oe/aa letters: a, o, a with the proper characters) are fine and expected in UTF-8.
- Use the Write tool to create the files (read each source fully first with the Read tool). Reply with only a one-line confirmation listing the files written.
